It reads the radar's own intensity trajectory (leak-free) plus the display-only central-bank liquidity series; unlike the alert legs it is not forward-tested yet, and risk can re-accelerate. The de-risk → re-risk response is sizing, scaled in deliberately. BoJ enters only via the aggregate global central-bank tide (no isolated BoJ feed).
